title: LAST FIVE YEARS CAST ALBUM APRIL 20TH!! #thelastfiveyears #rachelzegl...
transcript: I'm literally about to go to sleep, but the last five years with Rachel Ziegler and Ben Platt just finished at the Hollywood Bowl. And during bows, they announced there's going to be a cast album. I'm going to see the show on Monday at Radio City Musical, even though I was trying to avoid them. I've already seen so many clips from the London production, and I'm so excited. You just both sound so good, and we deserve. We deserve to have Rachel Ziegler captured forever. It's arriving on Monday, April 20th. That's so soon. But it was captured live during the concert residency at the London Palladium, conducted and directed by Jason Robert Brown. And the official title is The Last Five Years 25th anniversary live at the London Palladium. A little last five years history lesson. There are three last five years albums. We have the original cast recording with Shirene Scott and Norbert Leo Butz. I listen to that one once a week, if not more. We have the Adam Kantor and Betsy Wolff from 2013. And then we have the movie, which was 2015, with Jeremy Jordan and Anna Kendrick. But we did not get one for the Broadway production, so this is now our Broadway production. And I can't wait to see the show on Monday. And I can't wait to listen. Okay, now it's 1:00am. I should go to sleep.
classificationReason: Reacting to the cast album announcement from the London Palladium concert. Creator explicitly states she has not yet seen the show ('I'm going to see the show on Monday'), so no first-hand production opinion is given.
